4 أَثْكَلَتْ A state of bereavement clave to her; (K;) namely, a woman: or she became in a state of bereavement. (TA.) ＝
-A2- أَثْكَلَهَا ٱللّٰهُ وَلَدَهَا God made her to be bereft of her child [by death]. (Msb, K.) And اثكلهُ ٱللّٰهُ أُمَّهُ God made him to be bereft of his mother [by death]. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
